name: Daren Teller
source:
A handsome young om'veri with a mane like Azaries', as well as long whiskers, which makes Daren somewhat resemble an Eastern dragon. The lower part of the neck is protected by lighter, segmented plates. Daren's head is adorned with elegant horns curved backward, and his defined muzzle with a strong jaw and long, thin whiskers features large, golden-green eyes. Powerful webbed wings of a deep chocolate or burgundy color with golden veins and sharp growths on the edges unfold from his sides.
A polite and somewhat curious om'veri-sarantales. Apparently, he is quite a responsible individual, as he enjoys the trust of Umsargir — one of the leaders of the sarantales.
